title: UI风格#184 - Comic Book Pop (漫画书流行)
description: 创建第184种UI风格：漫画书流行风格 - 漫画书美学、网点效果、对话气泡。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planGB.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Comic Book Pop style When color palette Then features bold primary colors, halftone dots, high contrast
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#FF0000 (漫画红), #0000FF (漫画蓝), #FFFF00 (漫画黄), #000000 (黑色), #FFFFFF (白色)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Comic Book Pop style When typography Then uses comic display: Bangers, Comic Neue, or Permanent Marker
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Bangers (漫画标题), Comic Neue (漫画正文), Permanent Marker (手写)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Comic Book Pop style When layout Then panel layout, speech bubbles, action burst, halftone patterns
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：面板布局、对话气泡、动作爆发、网点图案

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Comic Book Pop style When UI elements Then speech pop, action lines, zoom burst, dot screen
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：对话弹出、动作线条、缩放爆发、点屏

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Comic Book Pop UI When functional Then includes panel chat, hero agents, power stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：面板聊天、英雄代理、力量统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Comic Book Pop UI When copy Then uses comic action: 'POW', 'WHAM', 'ZAP', 'BOOM'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'POW! WHAM! ZAP!'、按钮'SUBMIT'→'WHAM'、'DEPLOY'→'POW'
